channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Microsoft
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Microsoft, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2026 patches 1093 vulnerabilities (63 Critical, 1029 Important, 1 Moderate)
item.description:
Microsoft (multiple products): fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for the affected Microsoft products. The CCB advisories list the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix. The same day the CCB also warned: Critical SAP Vulnerabilities Allow Remote Code Execution.

Critical · Fix available

item.title: Patch: Microsoft Office: Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action
item.description:
Microsoft Office: Spoofing · pre-auth · remote · user interaction · exploited from day 0 · fix: 16.0.14334.21048, 16.0.17932.21140

First step: Update Microsoft Office to 16.0.14334.21048 or 16.0.17932.21140 or later.

Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2026-124194
